Open your eyes to the master plan they are executing right under our noses. The mainstream narrative tries to sell us a fairy tale about a natural "political transition" and a regime that is "tottering," but that is nothing more than a carefully constructed smokescreen for an orchestrated takeover by the hidden elites. 

Look closely at the script they are forcing us to swallow. They claim residents own nothing and are "too impoverished to take over the few functioning businesses on the island." That vulnerability is no accident at all—it is the core design of their plot. They engineered this entire manufactured crisis so that "a large and wealthy diaspora community (and potentially also foreign investors)" could execute a predetermined plan to "swoop in and buy property and businesses at bargain prices." 

It is a completely calculated trap by the syndicates pulling the strings behind the curtain, designed to strip everyone bare and hand over the assets while everyone is looking the other way.
